raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MiniMax-M3 stores sparse K/V in NHD and gathers selected blocks for AITER prefill. This PR stores sparse-layer K/V in the layout AITER paged attention reads directly, removing that gather and using the same consumer for prefill, decode and verification.

## Modifications

- Store sparse K/V in separate page16 SHUFFLE planes within the existing allocation, while keeping allocator pages at 128 tokens.
- Feed the AITER indexer's page tables into `pa_decode_gluon` and reuse selections across the existing layer groups.
- Enable the writer and consumer together for supported gfx950 FP8 HD128 configurations without PD disaggregation. Dense layers and index-K retain NHD storage.
- With HiCache, keep the SHUFFLE layout when pages move through `--hicache-io-backend kernel` with `--hicache-mem-layout layer_first`, which copies whole 128-token pages. Other HiCache transfers keep NHD.
- Add backend, cache-layout, scaling, long-context, graph-replay and HiCache host-pool regressions.

Depends on #41708. Set `SGLANG_M3_USE_AITER_SPARSE_PA=0` to disable this path.

## Accuracy Tests

`amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4`, MI355X, TP4/EP1, full 5-shot GSM8K (1,319 questions), chat-completions, 16384-token output budget, temperature 0, real EAGLE3 verification, 8 concurrent requests.

| Configuration | Strict-match | Flexible-extract |
|---|---:|---:|
| `SGLANG_M3_USE_AITER_SPARSE_PA=0` | 96.74% | 96.66% |
| This PR | 96.36% | 96.36% |
| This PR, HiCache (`kernel`, `layer_first`) | 97.04% | 96.97% |

Repeated runs of the same server vary by up to 7 answers.

25 GPU regression tests passed on MI355X with the enable flags unset: 10 sparse-PA, 9 indexer and 6 HiCache host-pool tests. Tested with AITER `e7d2453f25`.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

AgentX on MI355X, TP4/EP1, C32, no KV offload, 3600 seconds per run, and 10 warmup requests per lane. Both sides use EAGLE3 with simulated acceptance length 2.78, HD128 ASM prefill and AITER FP8 index selection; the candidate adds only SHUFFLE KV and sparse PA.

| Metric | Baseline | This PR | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Standard p90 interactivity (tok/s/user) | 43.45 | 49.99 | +15.06% |
| Total throughput (tok/s/GPU) | 37526.46 | 39944.68 | +6.44% |
| Output throughput (tok/s/GPU) | 242.68 | 256.17 | +5.56% |
| TPOT mean (ms/token) | 12.620 | 12.111 | -4.04% |
| TPOT p50 (ms/token) | 9.656 | 8.653 | -10.39% |
| ITL p99 (ms/token) | 74.364 | 96.477 | +29.74% |

Both formal runs had zero request errors. Grace-period cancellations were 1 / 0 and warmup errors were 1 / 0 for baseline / candidate.

- [x] Add unit tests.
- [ ] Update documentation.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

+# Copyright 2026 SGLang Team
+# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
+"""MiniMax-M3 index selection using AITER's FP8 score/top-k kernels.
+
+Retains SGLang's NHD KV pool and existing sparse attention consumer.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+
+@dataclass
+class AiterMiniMaxSelection:
+    topk: torch.Tensor
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+    context_lens: torch.Tensor
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Metadata:
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor
+    max_seq_len: int
+    query_len: int = 1
+    cu_seqlens_q: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    max_query_len: int = 1
+    row_req_id: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    kv_lens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    num_valid_pages: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+
+
+class AiterMiniMaxIndexer:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        max_context_len: int,
+        page_size: int,
+        num_index_heads: int,
+        num_kv_heads: int,
+        head_dim: int,
+        topk: int,
+        init_blocks: int,
+        local_blocks: int,
+        index_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    ):
+        if page_size != 128 or head_dim != 128 or topk != 16:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AITER MiniMax indexer requires page_size=128, head_dim=128, topk=16"
+            )
+        if num_index_heads != num_kv_heads:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AITER MiniMax indexer requires one index head per local KV head"
+            )
+        if index_cache.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn or not index_cache.is_contiguous():
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AITER MiniMax indexer requires a contiguous FP8 E4M3 index cache"
+            )
+        if tuple(index_cache.shape[1:]) != (1, head_dim):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AITER MiniMax indexer expects an NHD index cache with one KV head"
+            )
+        max_blocks = (max_context_len + page_size - 1) // page_size
+        if max_blocks > 8192:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AITER MiniMax indexer supports at most 8192 sparse blocks"
+            )
+
+        from aiter.ops.msa_attention import (
+            pa_sparse_block_score_decode,
+            pa_sparse_block_score_prefill,
+            pa_sparse_block_topk,
+        )
+
+        self.score_op = pa_sparse_block_score_decode
+        self.prefill_score_op = pa_sparse_block_score_prefill
+        self.topk_op = pa_sparse_block_topk
+        self.max_context_len = max_context_len
+        self.page_size = page_size
+        self.num_index_heads = num_index_heads
+        self.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads
+        self.head_dim = head_dim
+        self.topk = topk
+        self.init_blocks = init_blocks
+        self.local_blocks = local_blocks
+        self.metadata: Optional[_Metadata] = None
+
+    def prepare(self, req_to_token, req_pool_indices, seq_lens, query_len):
+        if self.num_index_heads * query_len > 16:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AITER MiniMax score supports at most 16 query-token/head pairs"
+            )
+        # A sparse block is an allocator page in this configuration. Rebuild
+        # from the live slot table once per forward, including graph replay.
+        block_table = torch.index_select(
+            req_to_token[:, : self.max_context_len : self.page_size],
+            0,
+            req_pool_indices,
+        )
+        block_table = (block_table // self.page_size).to(torch.int32)
+        self.metadata = _Metadata(
+            block_table, seq_lens.to(torch.int32), self.max_context_len, query_len
+        )
+
+    def prepare_prefill(
+        self,
+        req_to_token,

+    if (
+        k_cache.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        or v_cache.dtype != k_cache.dtype
+        or k_cache.shape != v_cache.shape
+        or k_cache.ndim != 3
+        or k_cache.shape[-1] != 128
+        or k_cache.shape[0] % 128
+        or not k_cache.is_contiguous()
+        or not v_cache.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "MiniMax AITER sparse PA requires contiguous FP8 page128 HD128 buffers"
+        )

+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        k_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        v_cache: torch.Tensor,
